sloka: एतावदेतदाख्यानं सोत्तरं ब्रह्मपूजितम् ।रामायणमिति ख्यातं मुख्यं वाल्मीकीना कृतम् ।। ७.१११.१ ॥
transliteration: etāvadetadākhyānaṁ sottaraṁ brahmapūjitam ।rāmāyaṇamiti khyātaṁ mukhyaṁ vālmīkīnā kṛtam ।। 7.111.1 ॥

translations.english: This is the complete narrative, including the Uttara Kanda, revered by Brahma, known as the Ramayana, and composed as the foremost work by Valmiki.
